nodes.text: Golden Friday favorites 🏆 1. fluidity_pour_paints (can not at)- dragon-mode campfire 2. @wildlife_curios - golden tree, own bench 3. @angelo_marcialis_photography - blooms on black 4. @frandoll.fd - Tennessee sunrise stream 5. @1982wildcatfan - swamp mirror autumn 6. @mammakates - gradient sunset 7. jglass8 (can not at) - kiss in the sun 8. @mike___zed - walker at golden hour 9. @allemor.romella - palms, ferry, gold Questions below - answer if you like!
photos: A vibrant bonfire burns in the dark, its yellow and orange flames accented by flashes of bright blue and green. The intense colors dance across stacked logs, creating a cozy and mesmerizing campfire scene.

A large, vibrant autumn tree overflows with golden-orange leaves, casting a warm glow over a wooden park bench nestled beneath its branches. A thick blanket of fallen leaves covers the ground in brilliant shades of yellow, red, and orange, creating a serene and picturesque seasonal scene.

A vertical medium shot captures a bouquet of bright yellow flowers in a white vase against a solid black background. The yellow petals resemble those of sunflowers. The white vase is long and narrow, with a curved design, resembling the shape of an hourglass. The image has a copyright notice in the bottom right corner that reads “© Angelo Marcialis Photography”.
Golden hour light filters through a dense forest canopy, casting a warm, glowing reflection on a serene, shallow creek.

A tall, golden-orange tree stands at the edge of a still body of water, its autumnal colors dramatically mirrored in the surface. The scene is peaceful and rustic, highlighting the vibrant beauty of the changing season.
A serene sunset casts a warm yellow and orange glow across a calm lake, with a distant treeline silhouetted against the horizon.

Captured from across the water, the iconic "Unconditional Surrender" statue in San Diego is silhouetted against a brilliant orange sunset, with the sun perfectly positioned behind the couple. The horizon is filled with warm, golden light and the silhouette of a nearby aircraft carrier.

A solitary figure strolls along a waterfront promenade during a vivid sunset, framed by the dark silhouette of a large tree overhead. In the distance, harbor lights and distant hills glow softly beneath a dramatic sky streaked with orange and yellow hues.

A golden sunset illuminates a scenic marina, casting the silhouettes of several tall palm trees against the bright sky. In the foreground, cars are parked along the waterfront near docked boats, creating a relaxed evening atmosphere.

replies.text: 1/9 fluidity_pour_paints That campfire looks like it's telling stories. Backyard ritual or a somewhere-special kind of night?
2/9 @wildlife_curios A tree with its own bench feels like a destination. Is this your regular thinking spot?
3/9 @angelo_marcialis_photography Yellow blooms on a black backdrop - studio setup or a happy accident of lighting?
4/9 @frandoll.fd Sunrise on your Tennessee stream - morning routine or a one-time lucky catch?
5/9 @1982wildcatfan That mirror reflection is unreal. How still did the water have to be for this?
6/9 @mammakates Distilled to pure gradient - were you going for minimalism or did the sky just hand it to you?
7/9 jglass8 The sun landing right inside the kiss - planned timing or pure luck?
8/9 @mike___zed A lone walker, a lamppost, golden hour - did you wait for the person or were they a gift?
9/9 @allemor.romella Palms, a ferry, full blaze - is this your everyday view or a special trip?
Daily sunset, most of the times, living in Southern California.
Envy of you 🤭

nodes.text: Photographers, Golden Friday 🌟 Show me the most golden thing in your camera roll. A sunflower, a sunset, a streetlamp glowing at dusk - if it glows gold, it counts. ONE photo. 3 favorites featured tomorrow, pin to my profile, and standouts may land in a weekend IG roundup with full credit. Yesterday’s favorites’ in.
photos: A close-up vertical shot features a single sunflower set against a clear blue sky. The yellow sunflower is the focus of the photo, with several other sunflowers in the background, out of focus.

A young deer stands alert along a sunlit dirt path, its fawn spots still visible against its coat. The surrounding lush grass and morning light create a peaceful, natural setting for wildlife viewing.
A close-up side profile of a large golden sculpture of a face dominates the foreground, with the Sydney Harbour Bridge visible in the background under a clear sky.

replies.text: Golden hour from my paraglider: the whole sky glows 🪂 Seeing the planet from above through a bird's eyes.
photos: A paraglider runs across a mountain launch pad during a golden sunset, with other gliders already aloft over a glittering sea.

A paraglider soars over a scenic coastline, with a bright red parachute contrasting against the deep blue water below and the lush green mountains in the background. The aerial perspective captures a breathtaking view of the beach and the surrounding landscape bathed in warm sunlight.

A silhouetted, gnarled tree stands prominently against a vibrant sunset sky filled with shades of orange and yellow. The horizon features a low, dark silhouette of scrubland, enhancing the serene yet dramatic desert landscape.

replies.text: My favorite dropped: https://www.threads.com/share/BAWeA5WRQw/

photos: A vibrant orange and red sunflower stands in full bloom, featuring a prominent brown center disk. A butterfly with patterned wings rests gently upon its face, adding a touch of natural beauty to the sunlit scene.

replies.text: A butterfly holding court on a flame-colored sunflower. Golden Friday's unofficial mascot.

photos: A brown skipper butterfly perches on a vibrant yellow zinnia flower, its wings folded upright. A single green leaf extends into the top right of the frame against a neutral grey background.

replies.text: A skipper butterfly sipping from a yellow zinnia. Small wings, big golden energy.
Finishing family photos in the last of the light last night.
photos: A vibrant golden sunset burns behind dark, dramatic clouds over a tranquil river, casting warm light onto the water's surface and the rocky shore.

replies.text: The last of the light doing overtime over the river rocks. Family photos with a golden encore.

photos: A bright yellow sunflower stands tall against a clear blue sky, its large blossom angled toward the sun. Below, lush green leaves cascade down the sturdy stalk, with a natural, overgrown field in the background.

replies.text: A sunflower towering into the blue, looking down at us for once. Golden from the ground up.

photos: A seagull flies across the sea at sunset, its silhouette framed by a golden-yellow sky and dramatic clouds with visible sunbeams.

replies.text: The sun clocking out through the clouds while a pelican takes the last flight home. Golden commute.
Golden enough? 😄🌅 This one still feels like bottled evening light.
photos: A sun-kissed woman takes a selfie while jogging along a scenic lakeside trail at sunset, wearing a grey athletic top and black leggings.

replies.text: Golden hour doing the heavy lifting while the mountains photobomb. Golden enough? Golden plenty.
I had a feeling the mountains might steal a little attention 😄🏔️
Inside Sagrada Familia.
photos: A low-angle view captures the soaring, tree-like stone columns and intricate vaulted ceiling of the Sagrada Família basilica, illuminated in warm orange and green tones by sunlight filtering through stained-glass windows.

replies.text: Gaudi doing golden hour before it was a thing. That light through the glass is unreal.
Sunset in Port Angles, WA
photos: A vibrant golden sun hangs prominently in the center of the frame, partially obscured by thin, wispy clouds. The entire sky is bathed in warm hues of orange and yellow, creating a serene and picturesque sunset.

replies.text: Port Angeles serving pure molten gold. The ocean's just showing off the reflection.

photos: A close-up, high-angle shot depicts bright yellow flowers in focus against blurred green leaves and foliage, creating a sense of motion.

replies.text: A swirl of yellow blooms caught mid-dance. Golden hour found them first.

photos: A vibrant orange and yellow sunset casts its warm glow over a calm, reflective sea under a partly cloudy sky. The silhouette of rocky outcrops borders the foreground, with the text "Stories and Scenery" subtly overlaid in the lower right corner.

replies.text: The horizon melting into gold, clouds doubled in the water. Signed and watermarked.
Roses in my garden. They’re called “Golden Medal”
photos: Vibrant orange and yellow roses bloom in a lush garden, showcasing their delicate petals against a backdrop of green leaves.

replies.text: Roses with their own gold medal. The garden's showing off and the name checks out.

photos: A low-angle view captures a forest of tall aspen trees with bright yellow leaves against a clear blue sky, evoking a serene autumn atmosphere.

replies.text: Standing under a cathedral of aspens, all gold overhead. Nature's stained glass, no filter needed.
We remarked on the stained glass feeling of it. Very magical!

photos: A vertical eye-level shot captures a vintage streetlamp standing in front of a tree whose leaves are vibrant yellow. The leaves are small and fan-shaped, and most of them cover the majority of the tree. The streetlamp is black with a white light at the top and the base is a dark gray. The lamp looks old and simple, like something you would see in a park or city square, while the bottom of the tree is partially covered by other trees and a building in the background.

replies.text: A lamppost drowning in gold leaves, still doing its job. Autumn's streetlight.

photos: A low-angle, full shot features a vibrant honey locust tree in peak autumn foliage, its brilliant yellow and green leaves contrasting sharply against a clear, deep blue sky. The slender, dark branches reach upward and outward, creating a dynamic composition ideal for a seasonal post about fall.

A large tree with vibrant golden-yellow autumn leaves stands tall in a suburban backyard under a clear blue sky. In the foreground, a chain-link fence and tall ornamental grasses frame the vibrant seasonal display.

replies.text: Golden trees showing off against that blue sky. Autumn doing its best impression of sunshine.

photos: A vibrant sunset paints the sky in shades of orange and purple above a silhouetted tree line and a street sign on Gladiola St NW.

replies.text: Sunset on Gladiola, and the sky signed it in orange. The stop sign's just there to make you stay longer.

photos: A high angle, close-up shot of several yellow Rudbeckia flowers in full bloom. The dark centers contrast with the bright yellow petals, as well as the purple flowers, green leaves, and grey stones in the background.

replies.text: Black-eyed Susans crowding the frame like they heard 'golden' and took it personally.

photos: A vintage yellow and silver Chesapeake and Ohio steam locomotive, number 490, sits on display inside a spacious industrial museum. Other historical train cars and museum visitors are visible in the background beneath the building's exposed steel rafters.

replies.text: Engine 490 in full golden livery. That's not a train, that's a sunset with wheels.

photos: Three red combine harvesters work their way across the steep, rolling hills of a golden wheat field under a pale blue sky. A trail of dust rises behind each machine as they harvest the grain, capturing a busy day during harvest season.

replies.text: Golden wheat rolling to the horizon, combines kicking up dust. Harvest gold, straight from the field.

photos: A heavy, mature sunflower head droops dramatically downward, its bright yellow petals wilting against the backdrop of a weathered wooden fence and a cloudy sky.

replies.text: A sunflower bowing out gracefully, seed head heavy with the season. Golden to the very end.

photos: A young person stands in a doorway, framed by a luminous, glowing ring of sparkling light created by a spinning sparkler. The long-exposure shot captures the bright, fiery trails of the sparkler against the twilight backdrop of a home exterior.

replies.text: A sparkler drawing a perfect golden halo. Long exposure magic, zero CGI.

photos: An eye-level, full shot shows the alter of a large cathedral. The alter and surrounding canopy are a gold-toned color. A crucifix hangs from the ceiling in front of a blue screen in the back. Two sets of plants are located at the base of the alter. The floor is made of green and orange squares in a grid pattern. Two chandeliers hang from the ceiling, one on each side. The walls are made of light grey bricks. A large circular stained glass window is visible above the canopy, behind the crucifix. The vaulted ceiling is made of grey bricks.

replies.text: Gold on gold on gold - that altar's been waiting centuries for Golden Friday.

photos: A herd of alpacas gathers around a hay feeder in an enclosed pen during a stunning sunset. The warm golden light illuminates the silhouetted trees and fields in the background.

replies.text: An alpaca welcoming committee at golden hour. The white one's clearly the greeter.
The boys had just gotten their dinner, they were happy as could be. 😊
Golden light, quiet seas, and a fleeting moment of serenity. ✨🌅 A little piece of gold captured through my lens.
photos: Two small boats float calmly in a glistening sea under a dramatic, cloud-filled sunset sky, viewed from a tranquil, sandy beach.

replies.text: Two boats floating on liquid gold under a sky doing its best drama. Serenity, captured.

photos: Captured through a window pane, a vibrant sunset paints the sky in shades of gold and blue above a parking lot filled with various cars. Trees and buildings line the horizon, completing the serene morning or evening scene.

replies.text: Even the parking lot gets a golden finale through that window. The sky's doing overtime.

photos: A close-up shot captures a vibrant yellow celandine poppy in full bloom amidst lush green foliage. In the soft-focus background, delicate bluebells add a contrasting splash of color to the spring garden scene.

replies.text: Two little buttercups glowing like they swallowed the sun. Spring energy crashed autumn's thread.
It’s actually celandine poppy. But yes, spring energy for sure 💛 https://www.wildflower.org/plants/result.php?id_plant=stdi3
#TIL

photos: A low-angle view captures a winding road bathed in the warm, golden glow of a setting sun. The sun casts long, dramatic shadows from a line of red and white bollards that border the street.

replies.text: The commute home, but the sun turned the whole street to gold. Rush hour never looked this good.

photos: A vibrant cluster of golden chain flowers hangs heavily in full bloom, their bright yellow blossoms contrasting sharply against dark green foliage and a misty sky.

replies.text: Golden chains of blossoms raining down. The tree's showing off and we're all just watching.

photos: A bright yellow flower is captured from a low angle, with sunlight filtering through its translucent petals against a clear blue sky.

replies.text: Shot from below like the sunflower's a skyscraper. Those petals are basically stained glass.

photos: A vibrant mural featuring a large yellow sunflower and white cotton bolls is painted against a bright blue background on a gray brick wall. White script above the floral arrangement reads "You Belong Here," creating an inviting street-art photo opportunity.

replies.text: A sunflower mural telling you you belong here, and the golden vibes agree.
Big Raccoon Creek. Mansfield, Indiana
photos: A sunny autumn landscape features a tranquil river, its surface shimmering with light, flowing past a grassy bank covered in fallen leaves. In the background, a red covered bridge is nestled among vibrant trees with golden and orange foliage, all framed overhead by green leaves hanging from a nearby branch.

replies.text: A red covered bridge crashing the golden foliage party. Big Raccoon Creek understood the assignment.

photos: A vibrant bouquet of yellow and cream roses, accompanied by a bright yellow gerbera daisy and delicate white filler flowers, rests inside a crinkled clear cellophane wrapper on a dark surface.

replies.text: A bouquet that smells like sunshine through the screen. The gerbera's the loud one in the group.
Variations on yellow
photos: A low-angle, medium shot shows an overcast sky with a radiant golden sunset breaking through the clouds, illuminating the horizon over the ocean and a dark shoreline with a cluster of palm trees in the lower right.
A golden retriever puppy takes a nap, stretched out on a wooden staircase as a patch of sunlight warms its fur.

replies.text: A golden sunset and a golden dog napping through it. The variations are strong with this one.

photos: A vibrant, sunny yellow marigold flower is captured in close-up, its densely packed, ruffled petals radiating from the center. The background is softly blurred with green foliage, creating a natural and inviting feel.

An adorable, fluffy orange tabby cat rests with its eyes closed, its plump cheeks flattened against a textured brown surface. The cozy close-up captures the sleepy feline in a state of pure relaxation.
A close-up shot of two vibrant yellow gerbera daisies in full bloom, nestled amongst lush green foliage.

A tiny insect, likely a bee, gathers pollen from the center of a bright yellow five-petaled flower. The flower is part of a lush green plant with heart-shaped leaves and unopened buds, set against a soft, out-of-focus background.

replies.text: Marigold, gerbera, and a ginger cat asleep mid-photoshoot. The cat's the most golden thing here and it knows it.

photos: A vibrant yellow hibiscus flower, dotted with glistening raindrops, is captured in a close-up shot against a dark, moody background. The intricate layers of its ruffled petals and delicate stamen are highlighted by the soft moisture, creating a serene and natural aesthetic.

replies.text: A hibiscus wearing raindrops like jewelry. Golden and dripping, literally.
Really appreciate your kind words, thank you..
Anytime - that hibiscus earned every word.

photos: A low-angle view captures a massive, rugged tree trunk extending upward, with its branches spreading out into a canopy of brilliant yellow autumn leaves. Glimpses of a bright blue sky peek through the golden foliage, highlighting the vibrant colors of the season.

replies.text: Lying on the forest floor, staring up at a tree doing its golden fireworks impression. Best seat in the woods.

photos: A striking autumn scene unfolds in a dense forest, showcasing vibrant red and golden foliage set against a backdrop of bare tree trunks. The contrast of the brilliant hues creates a warm, inviting atmosphere, perfect for a cozy fall day.

replies.text: Red maples arguing with golden everything. Autumn's having a full color debate and everyone's winning.

photos: A tranquil pond mirrors a vibrant sunset with cotton-candy pink clouds and lavender hues. Trees on the distant shore, touched with autumn's gold, add a seasonal warmth to the serene landscape.

A lone walker is captured from behind on a winding dirt path, heading toward a large, dark tree against a vibrant sunset. The dramatic sky features sweeping clouds painted in rich shades of orange, pink, and deep purple.

replies.text: The lake doing its best pink-sky impression, and nailing it. That reflection is showing off.

photos: A vibrant red-orange mushroom with a bright yellow stem stands upright amidst forest litter and moss. The low-angle shot highlights the delicate gills underneath its cap against a softly blurred green woodland backdrop.

replies.text: That mushroom dressed up as autumn itself. The yellow stem is doing all the talking.

photos: A fuzzy bumblebee feeds on the center of a bright yellow sunflower in full bloom, with a vast field of similar sunflowers stretching into the blurred, sunlit background.

A vibrant field of bright yellow sunflowers stretches towards a treeline under a partly cloudy sky, with the sun casting a warm glow from the upper left. A paved road borders the field in the distance, suggesting this picturesque rural landscape is easily accessible by car.

A vast field of bright yellow sunflowers stretches towards a dark tree line, basking in warm sunlight. Some blooms in the foreground are drooping toward the end of their season, while others stand tall and vibrant.

A vast field of bright yellow sunflowers blooms under a dramatic sky with scattered clouds and warm sunlight filtering through the trees. The expansive floral landscape stretches toward a dense forest edge, creating a vibrant and peaceful countryside scene.

replies.text: A bee clocked in for the golden shift. That sunflower's basically running a tiny honey factory.
Does a Golden Retriever count? 🤔
photos: A happy golden retriever wearing a yellow "Landshark" life jacket with a blue fin relaxes on the padded seat of a boat. The boat is on a sunny lake, with green trees along the shore and a partly cloudy blue sky in the background.

replies.text: It counts. It counts so hard the vest says LANDSHARK and the lake agrees.

photos: Golden sunlight breaks through a thick layer of clouds above a desert landscape dotted with saguaro cacti. The silhouette of distant mountains and rugged bushes frames the dramatic twilight sky, creating a peaceful and vibrant sunset scene.

replies.text: A saguaro standing guard while the whole desert turns gold. That cactus has seen a thousand of these and never brags.

photos: Framed by a round, warmly lit window high in a modern gray house, a person holds a cat aloft in a heartwarming silhouette. Green foliage partially obscures the bottom of the shot, adding a layer of depth to the tranquil scene.

replies.text: A cat framed in a porthole, glowing like a tiny ship's captain. Golden hour delivered by the captain himself.

photos: An overhead shot of four glasses of beer on a dark gray outdoor table with parts of people sitting around it.
A sunset paints the sky in shades of gold and blue, reflecting off the calm water of a lake. Silhouetted pine trees line the shore, with the sun peeking through their branches on the right side.

replies.text: Four golden pours lined up, then a sunset melting into the lake like it had nowhere else to be. Golden hour, fully committed - cheers to that.

photos: A large toadstool with a distinctive speckled, tan and white cap stands tall in a bed of wood chips. Its stalk is thick and bulbous, and the background shows a hint of greenery and a brick wall.

replies.text: Mushrooms flashing their gills like they invented the pose. The mulch runway, obviously.

photos: A high-angle view captures a city skyline at sunset, with golden light reflecting off the glass facade of a modern apartment building. In the foreground, a low-rise brick building and a balcony railing are visible under a partly cloudy sky.

A stunning, high-altitude view shows a vibrant pink and orange sunset over a city skyline, with wispy clouds stretching across the dusk sky. Below, a modern multi-story building and a street with light traffic frame the peaceful evening scene.
A small butterfly rests on the bright yellow petals of a vibrant sunflower, basking in the sunlight.

A vibrant sunset over a calm ocean casts a warm orange glow against a dramatic, cloudy sky. Overlaying the image in white text is an inspirational quote about endings being beautiful, accompanied by a small red heart icon in the lower right corner, suggesting it is styled for a social media post.

A wide-angle, eye-level, slightly high-contrast, exterior, outdoor, long shot of a countryside landscape featuring an open green field in the foreground, bordered by a dark green hedge that stretches across the middle ground. Several mature trees stand behind the hedge, with a larger tree with light-colored bark on the right. In the background, rolling green hills and valleys recede into the distance under a dramatic, multicolored sky with glowing golden sunlight peeking through the clouds. The lighting is bright and warm, illuminating the scene.

replies.text: Swamp Sunflower super bloom, Lake Jesup, Florida.
photos: A massive, sprawling field of bright yellow wildflowers blooms vibrantly under an overcast sky, with two small palm trees standing in the middle distance near a body of water.

replies.text: Dale Chihuly, Seattle
photos: A vibrant, spherical glass sculpture with yellow, red, and blue tendrils is displayed outdoors in front of a modern glass-paneled building with an arched roof. The sculpture sits atop a dark, mounded garden bed with lush green bushes at the base under an overcast sky.
A vibrant canopy of golden autumn leaves frames a tranquil lakeside view at sunset, with light filtering through the branches onto a leaf-strewn path.

replies.text: Autumn going full gold beside the lake. That light through the trees.
It’s my fave time of year 🤩

photos: A close-up captures vibrant yellow bougainvillea flowers with delicate, paper-like bracts blooming amidst lush green leaves, set in a potted garden.

replies.text: Backlit blooms glowing like little lanterns. Golden hour, bottled.

replies.text: The sun setting behind the house while the seed heads stand at attention. Golden hour, guarded.
